criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Staging register right with one lit subject per frame and the computed key. 8 low poly figures, clock moire, cite line over the near laptop; 5 a mitten hand on a slab torso; 4 a dark chair back mass; curled seat lips on 2, 7 and 9; 9 stacked floating slabs; 3 far lids alias.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One filmstrip, one desk, one world, the walk changing state, both devices working; 4 and 5 drop into a void and 8 cuts to a declared interior.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the weekdays check. Loosenings: 'two committees' put in the college's mouth from a plural; the caption's question presupposes the unread PDF is a separate adopted policy; slide 6 shows 13 pavers in frame against 'fourteen'; c18 medium.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and when to act; the deciding body honestly absent; the close carries no when or where.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and 2 pay, the turn lands on 4; 5 repeats rule 3; the timeline runs backwards from 7 to 8.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and compliant; reads as a fact checker's file; four disclaimer sentences; a generic cover hook.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Diverges from the last four decks; repeats no. 38's desk alone, field of desks and desk in a room beat for beat.

one_sentence_fix: Take the kit humans out of the light on 5 and 8, and on the slide 4 turn say only what the link title supports, dropping the caption's presupposition about the unread PDF.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Low poly figures lit frontally, clock moire, the near screen under the cite line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rim light only from the window; raise the near desk's screen clear of the source band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A three-finger mitten and a slab torso as the subject.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Backlight the hand against the lit page and crop the torso to the cuff.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A dark chair back as a dead bottom third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the chair from this camera or let the lid and page fill the lower two thirds.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stacked floating slabs behind the desk; a curled seat lip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera to about 1.2 m so the walk lies flat with contact at every joint; repair the seat shell lip.
Pull back so paver 0 sits whole above the source band.
